note: Per-family source hierarchy for the forward-only pregame archive. A family ships with whatever reliable pregame source exists today; unavailable sources are recorded honestly, never faked.

confirmed_lineup.timestampSupport: capturedAt (observed pregame); StatsAPI does not expose a lineup-posted timestamp, so availableAt = capturedAt (conservative upper bound)
confirmed_lineup.coverageNote: lineups post ~1-3h before first pitch; multi-snapshot cadence needed for high coverage
confirmed_lineup.leakageRule: final box-score lineup MUST NOT backfill a missing pregame lineup

pitcher_status.coverageNote: probable pitchers available for essentially all scheduled games
pitcher_status.leakageRule: actual target-game pitch count / innings MUST NOT enter a pregame record; projected pitch count is INTERNAL_ESTIMATE only

environment.timestampSupport: capturedAt; forecast issue time not exposed by StatsAPI
environment.leakageRule: observed target-game weather MUST NOT replace a missing pregame forecast; roof status captured as observed pregame

umpire.coverageNote: home-plate umpire assigned for some games early, more closer to game time
umpire.leakageRule: final box-score umpire MUST NOT substitute for a missing pregame assignment

markets.coverageNote: CAPABILITY DEFINED, NOT FETCHED in the free capture — full-slate two-sided odds needed for reproducible de-vig
markets.leakageRule: closing prices without an archived collection time are not research-eligible; team/game totals MUST NOT be reconstructed from final scores
markets.founderDecision: approving a paid odds source + its storage terms

sources: derived from strictly-completed prior team games (StatsAPI)
bullpen.timestampSupport: capturedAt; builder must include only games completed before capturedAt
bullpen.coverageNote: BUILDER PENDING — requires per-reliever prior-game workload with a strict completed-before rule
bullpen.leakageRule: a bullpen state may include only games completed before capturedAt; never let later games flow backward

plate_appearance_opportunity.coverageNote: PENDING markets; needs full-slate team/game totals across the window
plate_appearance_opportunity.leakageRule: current-game actual plate appearances MUST NOT enter the opportunity feature
